subject: general
question: Bleaching powder is NOT used for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**preparing bread**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bleaching powder** is commonly used for **disinfecting water**, **bleaching cotton**, and as an **oxidizing chemical**.
 
• It is not used for **preparing bread**
